instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 2: briefing newly rotated liaison officers during the shelter shift handoff
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Expert briefer assumes newly rotated, less-informed liaison officers share the same tacit facility-specific knowledge and terminology, resulting in an under-explained shift-handoff briefing, persisting even when time pressure is removed as a confound.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: The predicted label is the exact hidden target label, differing only in capitalization.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding captures the expert’s insider familiarity, the nonbinding twenty-five-minute time window, failure to unpack local shorthand or check listener knowledge, and the resulting communication failure.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted participant statements are verbatim and correctly attributed; they support the mechanism and distinguish it from a time-pressure explanation.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: It localizes correctly and overlaps the assumption that newcomers know local conventions, but false consensus effect is not an approved alias for Curse of Knowledge. It frames the error as social projection from a professional title rather than the expert’s failure to recognize that his own facility-specific shorthand is not transparent to newcomers. The hidden instance is already matched one-to-one by obs_002, so obs_001 is an extra duplicate prediction.

main_failure_modes: Added a moderate-confidence near-neighbor label for the same handoff episode, creating one duplicate prediction.
Reduced taxonomy precision by treating a distinct social-projection construct as a separate identified bias rather than abstaining or using the exact communication-calibration label.
main_strengths: Correctly identified the sole hidden occurrence.
Used valid, verbatim participant evidence and correctly distinguished the mechanism from time pressure.
Localized findings to the correct decision-point segment and produced no unsupported findings on negative segments.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has perfect recall and segment-level discrimination, but the additional moderate false-consensus finding lowers instance-level precision and F1 at the recommended high-and-moderate threshold.
